title: Columnar Storage, Parquet & Predicate Pushdown
interviewAnswer: Columnar formats store values by column, enabling compression and selective scans for analytics. Parquet also stores metadata/statistics that engines can use for predicate pushdown and row-group pruning.
keyPoints: Columnar is ideal for scans of a subset of columns.
Compression benefits from similar adjacent values.
why: Columnar Storage, Parquet & Predicate Pushdown is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
intuition: Columnar is ideal for scans of a subset of columns.
deepDive: Columnar formats store values by column, enabling compression and selective scans for analytics. Parquet also stores metadata/statistics that engines can use for predicate pushdown and row-group pruning. Compression benefits from similar adjacent values. File sizing/partitioning affect performance. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Read only date, user_id and revenue columns from a multi-terabyte Parquet dataset rather than full rows.

Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
